recommendations.why: Fits a straight-line model that predicts a numeric outcome from one or more numeric predictors, by least squares. It uses revenue (f64), seats (u16), score (f64), signup (date) and churned (packed_bool, 2 groups).

alternatives.when: the outcome is yes/no (0/1) or a count

the predictor is a set of groups and you want to know whether the group averages differ
